title: [react-instantsearch-nextjs] relax next.js peer dependency range to support v16
body:
### 🐛 Current behavior

currently, `react-instantsearch-nextjs` does not allow next.js v16 in its peer dependency range:

https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/blob/7cc565086f06a9ec74155002c26596b68efc53bc/packages/react-instantsearch-nextjs/package.json#L70

### 🔍 Steps to reproduce

in a next.js v16 project run `pnpm add react-instantsearch-nextjs`

### Live reproduction

n/a

### 💭 Expected behavior

no peer dependency error when installing with pnpm

### Package version

latest

### Operating system

_No response_

### Browser

_No response_

### Code of Conduct

- [x] I agree to follow this project's Code of Conduct

comments.body:
This issue should be resolved by #6791, which updates the peer dependency range to include Next.js v16.

The fix is available starting from `react-instantsearch-nextjs@1.0.4`, upgrading to that version (or later) should remove the peer dependency warning when using Next.js 16.
